findings.evidence: this Agreement and the Franchise will be governed by the internal laws of the State of Arizona (without reference to its choice of law and conflict of law rules), except that the provisions of any Arizona law relating to the offer and sale of business opportunities or franchises or governing the relationship of a franchisor and its franchisees will not apply unless their jurisdictional requirements are met independently without reference to this Paragraph.
findings.reasoning: Section 17.11 expressly designates Arizona internal law as governing the agreement, subject to certain federal statute carve-outs. This is a clear governing law provision.

findings.evidence: you and we hereby waive to the fullest extent permitted by law, any right to or claim for any punitive or exemplary damages against the other, and agree that, except to the extent provided to the contrary in this Agreement, in the event of a dispute between you and us, each party will be limited to the recovery of any actual damages sustained by it.
findings.reasoning: Section 17.10 waives punitive and exemplary damages and limits recovery to actual damages, which is a contractual limitation on liability.

findings.evidence: Except with respect to your obligations to indemnify us and claims that we may bring under Sections 7, 9, 15, or 16 of this Agreement, and except for claims arising from your non-payment or underpayment of any amounts owed to us or our affiliates, (1) any and all claims arising out of or related to this Agreement or the relationship between you and us shall be barred
findings.reasoning: The limitations of actions and damages waiver in Section 17.10 expressly carves out indemnity obligations, claims under Sections 7, 9, 15, and 16, and non-payment claims from the limitation, meaning those categories are not subject to the cap.

Termination provisions in Section 15 are all tied to enumerated breach or trigger events (termination for cause). There is no provision allowing the franchisee (or company) to terminate without cause at will on notice.

findings.evidence: Accordingly, neither this Agreement nor any part of your interest in it, nor any Interest (as defined in Paragraph 14.2) of Franchise Owner or a Principal Owner, may be transferred (see definition below) without our advance written approval if such transfer will result in the Principal Owner(s) set forth in Exhibit 4 holding less than a seventy-five percent (75%) Interest in Franchise Owner.
findings.reasoning: Section 14.4 restricts transfer/assignment of the agreement or interests without the Company's advance written approval, a classic anti-assignment restriction.

findings.evidence: As used in this Agreement the term "Transfer" means any voluntary, involuntary, direct or indirect assignment, sale, gift, exchange, grant of a security interest, or occurrence of any other event which would or might change the ownership of any Interest, and includes, without limitation: (1) the Transfer of ownership of capital stock, partnership interest or other ownership interest (including the granting of options (such as stock options or any option which give anyone ownership rights now or in the future); (2) merger or consolidation, or issuance of additional securities representing an ownership interest in Franchise Owner
findings.reasoning: The Transfer definition captures mergers, consolidations, and changes in ownership, which require the Company's consent under Section 14, constituting a change of control consent requirement.

The agreement expressly disclaims any protected territory and reserves the Company's rights to operate or grant others rights anywhere. There is no undertaking to deal exclusively or grant of exclusive rights in a defined territory. The non-compete restricts the franchisee's competing activities but is not an exclusivity/exclusive dealing grant.

findings.evidence: during the term of this Agreement, neither you, nor any Principal Owner, nor any member of your immediate family or of the immediate family of any Principal Owner, shall perform services for, or have any direct or indirect interest as a disclosed or beneficial owner, investor, partner, director, officer, employee, manager, consultant, representative, or agent in, any business that offers products or services the same as or similar to those offered or sold at The Joint Corp. Location franchises. The ownership of one percent (1%) or less of a publicly traded company will not be deemed to be prohibited by this Paragraph. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, you agree not to engage in a competitive business for a period of two (2) years after the termination or expiration and within twenty-five (25) miles of your Franchise Premises or any other The Joint Corp. Location franchise location.
findings.reasoning: Section 9.3 contains an in-term and two-year post-term non-competition covenant restricting the franchisee from engaging in competitive businesses within a defined radius.
